newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: U.S. tourists charged with cocaine import.
newsitem.headline: U.S. tourists charged with cocaine import.

text.p: Four U.S. backpackers were charged on Tuesday with importing 20 kg (44 pounds) of cocaine into Australia, worth an estimated A$12 million (US$8.7 million).
The three women and a man were arrested on Monday night, carrying five kg (11 pounds) of cocaine in each of their black backpacks, the Australian Customs Service said in a statement.
The backpackers arrived at Sydney airport on an Aerolineas Argentinas flight from Peru via Argentina and New Zealand.
Charged were San Francisco fashion designer Silvia Cuadra, 45, Orlando marine biologist Randall Quirk, 40, New York retiree Dora Bellorini, 62, and New York hairdresser Evelyn Ruiz, 35.
The group did not enter a plea in Sydney's Central Local Court to the charges of importing a prohibited narcotic and were remanded in custody.
